st.delivery.title: AfroTransact Delivery pricing
st.delivery.intro: AfroTransact Delivery from the seller’s store: the seller packs, the nearest AfroTransact driver collects and delivers. The customer pays the delivery charge; the seller pays the seller delivery fee, deducted from the payout.
st.delivery.include: Change AfroTransact Delivery pricing in this version
st.delivery.carriedOver: Left unticked, v{v}’s delivery pricing carries over unchanged.
st.delivery.noneYet: No version prices AfroTransact Delivery yet: left unticked, it stays not offered.
st.delivery.notChanged: The delivery pricing of v{v} carries over: payments copies it when a version leaves the section out.
st.delivery.notConfigured: No delivery pricing: AfroTransact Delivery from sellers’ stores is not offered (quotes answer NOT_CONFIGURED).
st.delivery.enabled: Offer AfroTransact Delivery from sellers’ stores
st.delivery.enabledHelp: Off: shoppers can’t choose it under this version.
st.delivery.radiusHelp: Road distance from the store; beyond it the offer can’t be delivered to that address. More than 0, up to {max}.
st.delivery.flatHelp: Multiplied by the number of packages.
st.delivery.distanceHelp: A band covering the distance sets the fee; otherwise base + per-mile × miles (rounded half up), then raised to the minimum and capped at the maximum. Packages don’t count.
st.delivery.overridesHelp: A negotiated seller delivery fee for one organisation. {retail} never pays a delivery fee.
st.delivery.noOverrides: No overrides: every seller pays the seller delivery fee above.
st.delivery.removeOverride: Remove the delivery fee override for {seller}
st.delivery.findSeller: Find a seller for a delivery fee override
st.delivery.hasOverride: already has a delivery fee override
st.delivery.err.amount: Enter an amount in dollars, e.g. 4.99
st.delivery.err.miles: Enter miles with up to two decimals, e.g. 7.5
st.delivery.err.radius: Enter the maximum radius in miles, e.g. 25
st.delivery.quote.title: Quote preview
st.delivery.quote.seller.label: Seller
st.delivery.quote.beyond: Beyond the radius: not deliverable to that address
st.delivery.current: AfroTransact Delivery: {customer} for the customer, {seller} for the seller, within {miles} mi
st.delivery.currentOff: AfroTransact Delivery from stores: not offered
st.pickups.intro: AfroTransact Delivery from the seller’s store: the seller packs and the nearest available driver collects. New pickups join the best driver’s route automatically; here you see the ones still waiting and can override with a reason.
st.pickups.waitingTable: Seller pickups waiting for a route
st.pickups.none: No seller pickups are waiting: every pickup is on a driver’s route.
st.pickups.lookup: Open a pickup by shipment id
st.pickups.lookupHelp: Routed pickups are not in the pool; open them here.
st.pickups.assignForm: Assign the pickup to a route
st.pickups.reason: Reason (required, kept in the assignment log)
st.pickups.reasonHelp: 5 to 500 characters, e.g. “Closer driver’s van is full”.
st.pickups.viewOnly: Read-only: assigning needs delivery:dispatch and edit access to dispatch.
st.pickups.noDriversHelp: No driver in the pickup’s zone has a fresh position, a passed inspection and room. The zone route builder will place it.
st.pickups.err.reason: Say why you assign this route (5 to 500 characters)
